summary: Frontend-only testing for LovePDF new features: mixed-file Merge PDF (PDF+image), auto-download behavior on server-side tools and image tools, header logo navigation, and scroll-to-top on route change. All 6 targeted test cases PASSED via Playwright with real download event capture and pypdf validation.
critical_code_review_comments: ToolPage.jsx is ~690 lines; consider splitting into smaller components (ResultView, options panels) for maintainability.
ResultView useEffect uses result.autoDone mutation on a prop object to guard against double-fire; works but non-idiomatic React (fine for now, but a useRef flag would be cleaner).
seed_data_creation: Used pre-existing /tmp/text.pdf, /tmp/scan.jpg, /tmp/scan.pdf. No new seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) merge-pdf accepts .pdf,image/* and produces valid 2-page merged.pdf from text.pdf+scan.jpg; (2) auto-download fires via hidden anchor on ResultView mount for both server blob results (pdf-to-word -> text.docx 36KB) and image tools (compress-image -> scan_compressed.jpg 14KB); (3) 'Download <name>' button remains visible after auto-download; (4) data-testid='logo-home-link' navigates to / correctly; (5) ScrollToTop resets scrollY=0 on route change (verified 1461->0); (6) Regression: 2 PDFs merge preserves total page count. Playwright expect_download successfully captured the auto-anchor click download.
